gaps: P0: none; P1: the Braun and Hogenberg plates are either an album sheet with the fold through a small, distant city (1572) or composite scenes of the isthmus and the tuna fishery with the city far off (vol. 5); no second P3 or P4 40 years apart
notes: #7: the imprint reads P. v. d. Berge; his Theatrum Hispaniae is usually dated about 1700 (Rijksmuseum gives 1694–1737), drop it if that is too loose. #17 (cathedral and sea wall by J. E. Puig) is a strong P4 alternative, but the Rijksmuseum date ca. 1860–80 does not fit Esplugas Puig (born 1852), so it is probably later. #13 (photochrom of the Puerta de Tierra, 1890s) is a color P4 option. #22 is Vejer de la Frontera, not Cádiz.
